skill.summary: Generate professional LinkedIn posts that engage your audience with original content on career milestones, industry insights, advice, and company updates.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of LinkedIn Post Generator skill.

- Generates tailored LinkedIn posts for various professional scenarios (thought leadership, milestones, company updates, etc.).
- Offers structured templates and formatting for different post types.
- Customizes posts based on input such as topic, audience, tone, and key points.
- Provides hashtag suggestions, engagement tips, and call-to-action options.
- Includes multiple post versions (personal, data-driven, concise) and best posting time recommendations.
